name: dobe_soft_edit
desc: Keep the same head, ears, pose and colors. Make the chest much broader and wider with big soft round pecs. Make the whole body softer and gooier: remove most of the sharp interior muscle lines, smooth rounded glossy slime blobs, more sagging and dripping goo. Change the eyes to human-like eyes: a yellow iris with a dark round pupil, half-lidded and sly. Remove the realistic dog nose bridge lines, keep the muzzle simple and smooth.
